Clean-to-Edge™ Soft Roller Brush with CelesTect™

The soft roller brush equips with a celeste light to expose hidden dust while efficiently cleaning hard-to-reach edges on hard floors. With a reduced 7mm* distance to the wall, it tackles side cleaning challenges and picks up debris along baseboards smoothly.

The pet deshedding tool effortlessly tackles pet fur challenges by combing and removing floating fur with ease. With a simple push, fur is directed straight into the suction inlet, simplifying grooming.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I choose the right suction power for different cleaning scenarios?
Eco Mode: Perfect for quick crumbs and tabletops cleanups.
Auto Mode: Delivers balanced performance for regular floor cleaning while optimizing battery life.
Turbo Mode: Offers maximum power for deep cleaning furniture gaps and stubborn dirt.
How often to clean the cyclone system and filter?
It is recommended to clean the cyclone system andpre- filter at least once every 3 to 4 months.
How to clean the roller brush?
To maintain your vacuum's performance: Press the release buttonto remove the brush. Gently cut away tangled hair/fibers and wipe the slot. If needed, rinse with water only (no chemicals) aand air-dry fully for 24 hours before reuse.
Should I clean the dust bucket?
It is recommended to wipe it with a wrung-out cloth at least ofnce a month.
What precautions should I take when using the vacuum?
To keep your vacuum working well, Please always use on dry surfaces and avoid flour/lime (they clump) or sharp objects. If powder gets inside, simply remove the filter and dustbin, tap ouit the powder, then clean and let dry before next use.
*310AW, 150,000 RPM: Based on tests in Dreame Lab, actual performance may vary. The 310AW suction power, which represents the highest value within the Dreame cordless stick vacuum product line as of May 2024.
*0.1µm, 99.99% whole-machine filtration efficiency: Based on tests conducted by SGS, report No.SHFT240300008571.
*99.9% bacteria and viruseses filtration efficiency: Based on tests conducted by SGS, report No.SHFT240300008872.
Specific bacteria and viruseses include Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Candida albicans, H1N1 Influenza viruses, and 229E Coronaviruses.
*HEPA H14: Based on tests from Suzhou GTT Service Co.,Ltd, report No.0340-24A-01.
*90 minutes: Based on tests in Dreame Lab, in Eco mode with the Combination Tool.
*300m²: Based on tests in Dreame Lab, in Eco mode with the two main brushes, actual performance will vary based your specific home layout.
*7mm: Based on tests in Dreame Lab. The distance between the right side of the roller brush to the wall is 7mm.
*The pet deshedding tool is specifically engineered to cater to dogs and cats with medium to long hair.
*Prior to commencing the suction collection process post-combing, it is advisable that your pets be kept at a safe distance from the operational vacuum or have acclimated to the auditory cues associated with suction.
